name: Clipboard and Screen Capture Permissions
description: Clipboard read/write and screen capture operations require explicit user consent per operation. Consent is recorded with receipts. No silent clipboard reading or screen capture.
purpose: Protect user privacy by requiring explicit per-operation consent for clipboard access and screen capture, preventing silent exfiltration of sensitive content.
acceptanceCriteria: Clipboard read operations require explicit user consent per operation
Clipboard write operations require explicit user consent per operation
Screen capture operations require explicit user consent per operation
User consent prompts identify the requesting extension/tool
Consent grants and denials produce security event receipts
Consent is scoped to a single operation (not persistent)
